battleFormations.name: Invasion Fleet
battleFormations.effect: Hyper-adaptations: Select one for the whole battle: Swarming Instincts ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] vs Infantry/Swarm), Hyper-aggression ([LETHAL HITS] vs Monster/Vehicle), or Hive Predators ([PRECISION] on a Critical Hit vs Character).

battleFormations.name: Assimilation Swarm
battleFormations.effect: Feed the Swarm: Each Command phase, HARVESTER units regenerate one nearby friendly unit — heal D3+1 wounds, or return a destroyed Infantry model (up to 3 for Endless Multitude units).

battleFormations.name: Crusher Stampede
battleFormations.effect: Enraged Behemoths: Below-strength MONSTER models get +1 to Hit; below-half get +1 to Wound as well. Full-strength non-Battle-shocked Monster units get +2 OC.

battleFormations.name: Unending Swarm
battleFormations.effect: Insurmountable Odds: After the opponent shoots and destroys a model from an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit, that unit can make a surge move of D6".

artefacts.name: Norn Emissary upgrade
artefacts.effect: Enhancement named in source notes — exact rules text/cost not confirmed; check codex/Wahapedia.

artefacts.name: Alien Cunning
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] After deployment, redeploy up to 3 units, any of which can instead be placed into Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: Perfectly Adapted
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] Once per turn, re-roll any one roll made for the bearer.

artefacts.name: Synaptic Linchpin
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] Extends Synapse Range to 9" around the bearer.

artefacts.name: Adaptive Biology
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability (4+ once damaged).

artefacts.name: Ominous Presence
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS MONSTER only] Add 3 to the bearer's Objective Control characteristic.

artefacts.name: Enraged Reserves
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS MONSTER only] The bearer can fight on death (melee) on a 3+.

artefacts.name: Null Nodules
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS MONSTER only] Once per battle, gain Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic Attacks.

artefacts.name: Monstrous Nemesis
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS MONSTER only] Add 1 to the Wound roll for the bearer's melee attacks against Monster/Vehicle units.

artefacts.name: Relentless Hunger
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] Add 2" to the bearer's Move characteristic.

artefacts.name: Naturalised Camouflage
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] In round 1, grant Benefit of Cover to up to 3 nearby Endless Multitude units.

artefacts.name: Piercing Talons
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] A Critical Wound scored by the bearer gains +1 AP.

artefacts.name: Adrenalised Onslaught
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] The bearer's unit can Pile-in and Consolidate 3" further.

artefacts.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS (excl. MONSTER) only] The bearer's unit can regenerate twice per phase via the Harvester ability.

artefacts.name: Instinctive Defence
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] Heroic Intervention costs -1CP near the Harvester; units near the Harvester gain Fights First.

artefacts.name: Biophagic Flow
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] Aura: extends the Harvester's regeneration range to 9".

artefacts.name: Parasitic Biomorphology
artefacts.effect: [TYRANIDS only] Add 1 to the bearer's Strength in melee; add 1 Attack after the first kill near the Harvester (persists).

armyRules.name: Synapse
armyRules.effect: TYRANIDS units within 6" of a friendly SYNAPSE model are 'within Synapse Range': Battle-shock tests are taken on 3D6 instead of 2D6; melee attacks gain +1 Strength.

armyRules.name: Shadow in the Warp
armyRules.effect: Once per battle, in either Command phase, force all enemy units to take a Battle-shock test (-1 to that test if within 6" of a friendly Synapse unit).

sourceNotes: Detachment rules/Enhancements verified against Wahapedia wh40k11ed where marked; entries carried over from prior data are unverified placeholders pending confirmation.
